text:
Alex Kim: Heads-up—I'll be in Amsterdam next week for the Inference Summit + our team offsite. Only taking a carry-on. Any must-pack items or transit tips?
Maria Chen: Pack for rain + bikes city. Waterproof shoes, a thin packable rain jacket, and a small umbrella. :umbrella:
Jamal Rivera: +1 on the rain. Also bring a decent power bank (30k mAh if you use your phone for maps all day) and an EU plug adapter (Type C).
Lee Park: Compression cubes are a game changer. Roll socks, fold shirts. One outfit that layers—mornings are chilly even in summer.
Olivia Singh: For local transit: contactless bank cards work on trams, but if you want cheaper fares grab an OV-chipkaart at the station. Download 9292.nl for route planning.
sasha-bot: Reminder: please add your flight + hotel to the team itinerary doc so we can coordinate drop-offs.
Jamal Rivera: Hotel tip: request an early check-in via the app if you have a morning arrival. Ask for a room away from the street — bikes and late-night bar noise can be louder than expected.
Alex Kim: Any advice on toiletries for carry-on? TSA won't be fun.
Maria Chen: Go solid where possible: shampoo bar, solid conditioner, deodorant stick, toothpaste tablets. If you need liquids, 100ml bottles in a clear zip bag.
Lee Park: Bring a small EU power strip if you're sharing rooms. Hotels never have enough outlets near the desk/bed.
Olivia Singh: Snacks: bring 2-3 protein bars. Airports (and conference coffee lines) can be brutally slow.
Jamal Rivera: Seat picks: aisle for quick pee runs, window if you want to nap and lean. For a redeye bring a good eye mask and a travel pillow.
Alex Kim: Can someone drop a quick minimalist carry-on packing checklist I can copy?
Maria Chen: Sure—here's my go-to (fits a 22" carry-on and a laptop backpack):
```
- 3 shirts (mix short and long sleeve)
- 2 pants (one jeans, one lightweight)
- 1 light waterproof jacket
- 1 set of nicer outfit for dinner/event
- underwear + socks (4) packed in compression cube
- packable shoes (sneakers) + thin flip flops
- solid shampoo bar + toothpaste tablets + deodorant stick
- travel adapter (EU) + small power strip + 30k power bank
- toiletry zip bag (if any liquids 100ml max)
- neck pillow + eye mask (if red-eye)
- reusable water bottle (empty through security)
- small first-aid + blister patches
- 1 foldable tote for schwag
- phone charger + USB-C cable
- passport + printed hotel confirmation + digital copies in 1Password
```
Alex Kim: Legend. Thanks! Any Amsterdam-specific dos/don'ts?
Lee Park: Do rent a bike if you feel confident. Don't block bike lanes — locals are ruthless. :biking_man:
Olivia Singh: Do try the stroopwafels. Don't assume cash is king — cards are widely accepted.
Jamal Rivera: Also, get travel insurance if you're doing multiple flights. Saved me once when a connection got messed up.
Alex Kim: Perfect. I'll update the itinerary and ping you all if I need a hand with transfers. Thanks team! :raised_hands:
